eras.title: A port between sea and desert
eras.caption: Berenike linked the Red Sea with roads across Egypt's Eastern Desert. Excavated buildings, pottery and traded goods recover the history of a port through which people and cargo moved between Africa, the Mediterranean and the Indian Ocean.
